title: Indian Navy Agniveer SSR Full Length Mock Test 24 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for Indian Navy Agniveer SSR. 100 questions covering English, Science, Mathematics and General Awareness.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Each correct answer carries 1 mark. Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
Duration: 60 minutes. Manage your time wisely.
There is no sectional time limit. Attempt all questions.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part which has an error: Neither the sailors nor the captain were prepared for the sudden storm that hit the ship.
options: Neither the sailors nor the captain
were prepared for the sudden storm
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'Captain' is singular, so 'was prepared' should be used.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to 'EPHEMERAL':
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time; transient is the closest synonym.

questions.explanation: Candid means truthful and straightforward; deceitful is the antonym.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: What does the idiom 'Bite the bullet' mean?
options: To endure a painful or difficult situation with courage
questions.explanation: Bite the bullet means to face a difficult or unpleasant situation with courage and determination.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change the voice: The captain ordered the sailors to lower the sails.
options: The sailors were ordered by the captain to lower the sails.
The sails were ordered to be lowered by the captain.
The sailors ordered the captain to lower the sails.
The sails ordered the sailors to lower them.
questions.explanation: The object 'the sailors' becomes the subject in passive voice, with 'were ordered'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Convert to indirect speech: The officer said, 'We will reach the port by evening.'
options: The officer said that they would reach the port by evening.
The officer said that we will reach the port by evening.
The officer said that they will reach the port by evening.
The officer said that we would reach the port by evening.
questions.explanation: In indirect speech, 'will' becomes 'would' and 'we' changes to 'they' according to the reporting verb.

questions.question: Select the correct improvement: He is one of those sailors who has never been late.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Passive form of: They are repairing the damaged hull.
options: The damaged hull is being repaired by them.
The damaged hull was being repaired by them.
The damaged hull has been repaired by them.
The damaged hull is repaired by them.
questions.explanation: Present continuous active becomes 'is being repaired' in passive.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Indirect speech: The captain ordered, 'All hands on deck!'
options: The captain ordered that all hands should be on deck.
The captain ordered all hands to be on deck.
The captain said that all hands were on deck.
The captain ordered all hands on deck.
questions.explanation: Imperative sentences in direct speech become infinitive form in indirect speech.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Meaning of 'MARITIME':

questions.explanation: Maritime means connected with the sea, especially in relation to seafaring commercial or military activity.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: The ship has been sailing since three days.
The ship has been sailing for three days.
The ship is sailing since three days.
The ship sails since three days.
questions.explanation: 'For' is used with a period of time (three days), 'since' with a point of time.
